The '''sporting blaster pistol''' was a light, thin-barrelled [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] variant often used by those of noble heritage, who preferred a more elegant alternative to the uncivilized standard blaster.

==Description==
Sporting blasters were designed for use in firing ranges, small-game hunting,<ref name="TRG1" /> and personal defense.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> The blaster pistol variants were associated with [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] rich and powerful who wanted a blaster for personal protection but not an awkward, cumbersome [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. Nobility appreciated the fact that they could be agilely broken down into three parts and reassembled after transport. Being light and easy to carry, they were sometimes used for dueling.<ref name="TRG1" /> While they had a shorter range and packed less power than a standard blaster, these aspects helped make the blaster pistols highly affordable and obtainable by nobles and non-nobles alike - with little bureaucratic hassle required.

==History==
Elegant sporting blaster pistols were used by the [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens/Legends|Royal Handmaidens]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], an exclusive security force of young women charged to protect the elected [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of Naboo.<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref> The availability of sporting blasters over other blaster types also made them popular among members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] herself often carried a [[Drearian Defense Conglomerate/Legends|Drearian Defense Conglomerate]] [[Defender sporting blaster pistol/Legends|Defender sporting blaster]] during missions for the Rebellion.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" />
